### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of the sarek output (csv/, reports/, variant_calling/, annotation/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC name of the assembly the run was aligned to (hg38, hg19, mm10): the axis and gene lane of every locus track. |
| `TRACKS_URI` | — | s3:// or https:// folder holding the run's results (the one that holds csv/, variant_calling/, annotation/ and preprocessing/), to read the genome-browser tracks (the callers' VCFs and the CRAMs) in place instead of uploading them from DATA_ROOT. Without it the `tracks` collection uploads whichever of those files DATA_ROOT holds. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`bcftools/stats_sections.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_sections.py) | The distribution blocks of `bcftools stats`, melted into one long frame. | `sample`, `caller`, `section`, `bin`, `label`, `count` |
| [`bcftools/stats_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_summary.py) | Per-sample, per-caller variant record counts from `bcftools stats`. | `sample`, `caller`, `n_records`, `n_no_alts`, `n_snps`, `n_mnps`, `n_indels`, `n_others`, `n_multiallelic_sites`, `n_multiallelic_snp_sites`, `snp_fraction`, `log10_n_records` |
| [`bcftools/stats_tstv.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bcftools/stats_tstv.py) | Per-sample, per-caller transition/transversion ratio from `bcftools stats`. | `sample`, `caller`, `ts`, `tv`, `ts_tv`, `ts_1st_alt`, `tv_1st_alt`, `ts_tv_1st_alt` |
| [`mosdepth/regions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/regions.py) | Per-target mosdepth depth, binned into a genome-wide coverage track. | `chromosome`, `position`, `end`, `value`, `sample`, `stage`, `sample_stage`, `n_targets` |
| [`mosdepth/summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/summary.py) | Per-contig coverage summary written by mosdepth. | `sample`, `stage`, `scope`, `chrom`, `length`, `bases`, `mean_depth`, `min_depth`, `max_depth` |
| [`mosdepth/xy_sex_check.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mosdepth/xy_sex_check.py) | X and Y mean depth per library, and the sex the ratio is consistent with. | `sample`, `stage`, `x_coverage`, `y_coverage`, `xy_ratio`, `inferred_sex` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/ann_variants.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.11.0/recipes/ann_variants.py) | One row per annotated germline variant call, read from SnpEff's annotated VCF. | `sample`, `caller`, `chrom`, `pos`, `variant_key`, `ref`, `alt`, `variant_type`, `qual`, `filter_status`, `is_pass`, `gt`, `dp`, `vaf`, `gene`, `gene_id`, `impact`, `consequence`, `hgvs_p`, `aa_pos` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/caller_overlap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.11.0/recipes/caller_overlap.py) | Which callers make each call: one row per call in a sample, one 0/1 column per caller. | `sample`, `variant_key`, `n_callers`, `sample_shared_pct` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/callset_qc.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.11.0/recipes/callset_qc.py) | One QC profile per callset (sample and caller), for a parallel-coordinates tile. | `callset`, `sample`, `caller`, `n_records`, `snp_fraction`, `ts_tv`, `multiallelic_pct`, `pass_pct`, `het_hom_ratio`, `median_dp`, `median_het_vaf` |
| [`nf-core/sarek/cnv_segments.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/sarek/3.11.0/recipes/cnv_segments.py) | CNVkit copy-number segments and bins, one profile per calling unit. | `sample`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `log2`, `baf`, `copy_number`, `segment`, `label`, `depth`, `unit`, `unit_type`, `patient`, `normal`, `call_source` |
